verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only the reverse direction: external MCP-capable agents like Claude and Cursor connect to Airbyte's own MCP servers. Nothing shows Airbyte acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools. Server-side MCP evidence belongs to a different story and does not transfer here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
